node.title: UPSTREAM (Vadim, integrated by Przemek): the full-petal coset-chart residue-line bridge
node.statement: PROVED-LOCAL / NORMAL-FORM (693-line verifier, upstream main ab8d125b): in a full-petal coset chart (H of order ell, t distinct active petals, C a union of H-cosets), every capped kernel set is EITHER quotient-coset structured OR emits a low-degree projective residue pair, which after cancelling simultaneous active quotient-label basepoints becomes ordinary residue-line data on the surviving labels. Consumes the merged L1 collapse chain (coset-petal rank collapse + general reconstruction collapse). NOT a primitive-vacancy theorem — the prime-ell mixed minimal examples are classified by the residue data, not excluded.
